title: Globalisation Adventure
welcome_lead: Your phone, your trainers, your dinner — they came from everywhere. 🌐
meta_desc: Global Economy Adventure 1 — KS3 Economics on globalisation and global supply chains.
final_note: You learned what globalisation is and how it shapes daily life.

concepts.def: Countries trading and linking up worldwide
Business with offices in many countries
Steps moving a product from raw to shelf
Hiring another country to do work
Group of countries that trade freely

walkthroughs.body_html:
Globalisation = the world becoming more connected through trade, travel and tech.

Cheap shipping and the internet pushed it forward.

An iPhone has parts from many countries:

  • Designed in California.
  • Glass from Japan.
  • Chips from Taiwan.
  • Assembled in China.

This global supply chain makes the iPhone cheaper. 🌍

Multinationals like Coca-Cola, Toyota and Nike operate in dozens of countries.

Trade blocs like the EU let members trade without tariffs.

The WTO sets rules so trade is fair.
